items.title: ‘Spotify is now an agent’ – Co-CEO outlines company’s AI plan
items.excerpt: We’ve been following the burst of launches of personal agents – Meta’s Muse, OpenAI’s Dots and Anthropic’s Claude Duet – with keen interest recently. Unsurprisingly, so has Spotify.

items.title: Anthropic takes on Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots with Claude Duet
items.excerpt: It’s a strange moment for AI and humanity. Lots of headlines about how unregulated frontier-models could kill us all in the next decade – but of course, the big AI firms have some ideas on how that regulation should work – and growing unrest around the impact of the data centres those companies need to build for their next wave of growth.

items.title: Spotify Co-CEOs Talk AI Remixing Tool: ‘We’re the Right Company to Do This’
items.excerpt: Spotify's co-CEOs discussed the coming AI music remixing tool for the platform's subscribers, saying it will generate new revenue for the industry.

items.title: AI-Generated Music and the Future of Creativity Discussed at Billboard Latin Music Week
items.excerpt: AI in music and protecting human creators was discussed at a Billboard Latin Music Week panel featuring Cristina Perpiñá-Robert and Pierre Hachar Jr.

items.title: A$AP Rocky Has a Very Diplomatic Stance on AI in Music: ‘Who Am I to Say What’s Standard’
items.excerpt: A$AP Rocky revealed his thoughts on the growing use of AI in music.

items.title: Suno v. MLC Subpoena Dispute Boils Over Amid UMG Lawsuits
items.excerpt: After months of back and forth, a subpoena dispute has boiled over between Suno and the Mechanical Licensing Collective (MLC).

items.title: ICMP Says Australian Songs Used to Train AI Sans Compensation
items.excerpt: The ICMP warns that Australian copyright laws are at risk of being watered down for AI training, effectively "legitimizing larceny."

items.title: Is There a Future for 'Humanoid Robot Performances'?
items.excerpt: South Korea-based Galaxy Corporation is combining entertainment IP, AI, and humanoid robots for an upcoming Halloween-inspired event in CA.

items.title: Loopmasters’ sampling powerhouse Loopcloud just got a massive update – here’s what’s new
items.excerpt: Loopcloud 8 brings new intelligent tools for idea generation, new effects, fresh presets for FLIP, and a brand-new iOS app for laying down ideas on the go.

items.title: Piano2Pop: Expanding Piano Demos into Pop Productions Without Aligned Supervision
items.excerpt: We introduce Piano2Pop, a music-expansion task that transforms piano MIDI into instrumental pop productions. items.title: Music Tectonics Returns Next Week With AI, Artist Revenue, and Our Future on the Agenda
items.excerpt: The conference brings artists, industry leaders, and tech innovators to Santa Monica October 27–29 for three days exploring how to grow the music business.

items.title: Elektron Responds To Explosion Of Unofficial Firmware
items.excerpt: In his latest video, Matthew Piecora (EZBOT) shares his takeaways from an in-depth conversation with Elektron about the recent explosion of alternative firmware for their devices.

items.title: Midicake UNA Combines Generative Sequencing With Hands-On MIDI Control
items.excerpt: Midicake UNA is a hardware MIDI performance sequencer that uses the chords you play to generate coordinated chord, melody and bass parts for external synthesizers.

items.title: Erica Synths LXR-02 Desktop Drum Synthesizer: Now Open Source!
items.excerpt: Erica Synths makes their LXR-02 digital drum machine open source and invites everyone to go crazy vibe-hacking it. Is this the new FM-1?

items.title: Suno admits it has not deleted all the recordings used to train its AI, in answer to UMG and Sony's 'laundering' lawsuit
items.excerpt: In a 44-page answer filed October 20 in the US District Court for Massachusetts, Suno admits it has not deleted all of the recordings it used to train its AI models, responding to UMG and Sony's 'laundering' claims.
